mainEntity.name: When should a business invest in customer query research?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business should invest in customer query research at several key stages: when launching a new product or service, before embarking on a new content marketing campaign, during website redesigns, or if current digital marketing efforts are not yielding desired results. It's also beneficial for businesses looking to expand into new markets or better understand competitor strategies. Regularly conducting this research ensures that marketing efforts remain relevant and responsive to changes in customer behavior and search trends.
acceptedAnswer.description: Businesses should invest when launching new products, starting content campaigns, redesigning websites, or if current marketing is underperforming, and regularly to stay relevant.
